prompt:
As the number of older people grows, many countries do not have enough trained staff to look after those who need help with daily life.

What problems does this cause and what measures could be taken?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both halves of the task must be covered: first the problems, then the measures that could be taken

At least two concrete problems: the safety and health of older people who cannot get care; the burden falling on family members, often people who have to give up their jobs; existing staff burning out

The measures should match the problems: improving the pay and status of care work, short free training programmes, services that support home care, leave and respite support for families, neighbourhood-based volunteer networks
The solution is more convincing if it notes that part of the cause is the work being low-paid and demanding
A brief evaluation of which measure is most realistic is expected in the conclusion
common_mistakes: Explaining why the population is ageing without moving on to the real issue, the staff shortage
Simply saying 'the government should spend more money' without explaining the mechanism
Describing older people as a single, passive group
